create_distributor: create a Distributor instance from a param group to merge and block parameters for single-GPU Shampoo optimizer training
review_distributorinterface: review the DistributorInterface abstract class and its update_params abstract method for implementing custom distributed Shampoo distributors
merge_and_block_gradients: call merge_and_block_gradients on a Distributor to merge small dims and block gradients after optimizer step
update_params_foreach_add: call update_params on a Distributor to apply blocked search directions to local masked blocked parameters using foreach_add
construct_composable_block_ids: call _construct_composable_block_ids to generate composable block id tuples for parameter blocks with optional FSDP rank
